prompt:
A battle background for a side-on JRPG battle scene (the party will stand on the right, monsters on the left; no characters are drawn), in rich high-resolution 2D pixel art. The world is in an endless night: the sun has vanished and people live by lamplight. Setting: deep inside a mine / underground forge city. Back (top 42%): a vast cavern with wooden scaffolds, rope lifts, rail bridges and distant molten-orange forge glow, hanging chains. Ground (lower 58%): dark rock floor with rail tracks curving at the sides, ore chunks and a cart. Light: orange forge glow from the far back, cool blue ore light, deep shadows. The ground plane recedes from the bottom edge up to the horizon line at a low 3/4 angle; the middle of the ground (from 55% to 90% of the height, centre and right) is open, fairly flat and uncluttered: space for the battle. Details (rocks, plants, debris) sit at the sides and far away. 
No lantern, no fire in the middle, no people, no monsters, no text, no UI.
Pixel art: every art pixel is 4x4 image pixels (the image is 960 x 540 art pixels), crisp square pixels, no anti-aliasing, hue-shifted colour ramps (shadows toward violet, lights toward warm yellow), clusters with clear shapes, not a painting.
revised_prompt: Generate a wide 16:9 JRPG side-on battle BACKGROUND ONLY, no characters. Rich, high-resolution, strictly crisp 2D pixel art. Endless-night fantasy setting: deep within a mine and underground forge city, sunlight gone, civilization survives by distant forge light. Upper ~42% is an immense dark cavern interior with layered wooden scaffolding, rope lifts, narrow rail bridges, hanging chains, tiny distant molten-orange foundry/forge glow and violet shadowy rock, cool glowing blue ore veins. Lower ~58% is a deep-perspective dark rocky ground plane receding upward from bottom edge to a horizon line at low three-quarter angle, dramatic readable perspective. IMPORTANT gameplay composition: the central and right portions of the ground spanning approximately image y=55% through 90% must be OPEN, fairly FLAT and uncluttered for battle sprites; open space also for monsters at left. Rail tracks curve along the far sides, and clusters of ore chunks, one small mine cart, rock debris and architectural detail are situated along edges and distant background, not center battle space. Atmospheric contrast of far-background orange forge glow versus cool blue ore light, deep violet-shifted shadows and warm-yellow-shifted highlights. Deliberate pixel clusters, clear silhouettes, precise pixel-art tiles, evocative high-detail classic JRPG background. NO lantern, NO fire in middle, NO people, NO monsters, NO text, NO UI, NO characters.
